scope: Exploratory source-fit/source-validation diagnostic, no new outer-target scoring, no independent generalization or deployment claim
preprocessing: Reuse original fixed8 CAR, 8-30Hz500sample completed2s waveforms without new acquisition filtering or raw MAT
time_split: Original500samples split into0:250 and250:500, fixed order, no overlap or new trials
frequency_split: Whole500sample orthonormal real DFT; retain all bins via complementary masks f<14Hz and f>=14Hz at250Hz; irfft with n500. Not exact8-14/14-30Hz, residual outside original passband retained. Noncausal periodic completed-window diagnostic, not a streaming filter
feature: All component covariances divided by SAME whole-trial parent trace, not their own trace; existing log_covariance adds0.05*(component trace)/8*I then weighted matrix logarithm. Relative component energy preserved; absolute whole-trial scale removed. WHOLE equals previous fixed log feature
normalization: StandardScaler fit on26 source people only; standardized vector times sqrt(36/d) so source average squared norm is36, not equal capacity
budget: Exactly30 original folds x4conditions=120 deterministic fits, fixedC0.1, no C/frequency/time-grid selection, all120models frozen before source-validation scoring
validation_scope: Same26source fit/3source validation, exclude own outer person; all original trials of source validation people, no prefix cutoff.28 unique validation people;14and28 absent, appearance counts1-7. First average each person's BA across validation appearances, then equal average28; never treat90 appearances as independent people

bootstrap.limitation: Source training sets overlap; this descriptive interval is not independent fold/confirmation inference

interpretation: Pass only nominates joint representation for a separately locked outer comparison, not promotion. Secondary comparisons do not replace primary. Feature dimensions, segment covariance estimation and fixed post-scaling differ; gain cannot uniquely prove causal information loss
bad_trial_policy: Keep6080original trials/515author flags; no bad-person/trial deletion or silent flat-component imputation

verification.independent_solver: Existing analytic trust-exact plus declared Newton residual refinement, gradient infinity norm<=1e-6
verification.independent_feature: scipy FFT masks and Schur logm, common parent trace

input_identity_probes: Label-free fixed random sample permutations leave WHOLE covariance unchanged; temporal halves swap under swapping input halves; complementary FFT reconstructs waveform and whole covariance. Probes not new scored models
